about_the_game:
In this cozy singleplayer mining exploration adventure, you explore mysterious caves in search of ancient treasures and artefacts. Bring your excavated loot safely back to the surface and sell them to the local merchant, or use them to upgrade and enhance your with gemstones hammers at the blacksmith.

But rest assured, you will need all the help you can get to uncover the island's long-buried secrets and overcome a mysterious threat from below!

Excavate Treasures

Be strategic when mining. Use your hammers carefully to unearth treasures and artefacts hidden under different layers of rock of varying hardness. But beware, with each hammer hit, the wall loses stability and gets closer to collapse!

Find Legendary Hammers

Your hammers are an integral part of the game. Start off with only your trusty pickaxe to defend yourself, and as you progress unlock new hammers with special abilities to traverse the underground! You also need them to excavate treasures inside the mining minigame. So choose wisely which hammers you bring with you.
If you're lucky, you might even find legendary hammers on your journey...

Explore Procedurally Generated Caves

Descend deeper and deeper into the mysterious caves and discover 8 unique cave biomes, each with its own gimmicks and twists. Better treasures and also more dangers await the deeper you go. Every 10 floors, you will face challenging bosses or puzzling obstacles.

Features:

  • Excavate countless treasures in a captivating mining minigame

  • Upgrade your hammers & enhance them with gemstones

  • Discover 8 cave biomes with unique gimmicks, enemies and loot

  • Fight enemies and engaging boss battles

  • Expandable backpack with a tile-based inventory

  • Complete quests for the villagers

  • Solve puzzles and uncover the lore of the island

  • You can pet Shadow (the dog)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790K | Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 7 1800X | AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650, 4 GB or AMD Radeon RX 480, 4 GB
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows Soundcard
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700 | Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 7 2700X | AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060, 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 590, 8GB or Intel Arc A750, 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows Soundcard
